cohort: 21,697 Women who had institutional births in 12 hospitals in Nepal over an 18-month period
finding: Despite a high coverage of the Maternity Incentive Scheme (96.5%), out-of-pocket expenditure for institutional births in Nepal remained significant, varying by mode of delivery and duration of hospital stay.
mod_finding: The median OOPE was higher among women who had cesarean births compared to those who had vaginal births ($43.3 USD vs $32.6 USD).
